caption:
An empty page doesn't challenge your thoughts — it confirms them. When you write "I think she's upset with me" and nothing pushes back, your brain takes the silence as proof. The Fact Check turns your journal from an echo into a mirror. DM "JOURNAL" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this. Send it to someone who journals and still spirals.

#journaling #overthinking #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: your journal agrees with everything you think
